Mercury.1: Mercury in its own place gives children, knowledge, and science
Mercury.2: in the second it destroys speech and memory
Mercury.3: in the third it destroys quarrels, diseases, and illness
Mercury.4: in the fourth it produces insipidness in one's speech and intelligence
Mercury.5: in the fifth it gives success with respect to good qualities, fame, sons, and money
Mercury.7: in the seventh Mercury causes disrespect, diseases, and illness
Mercury.8: in the eighth it gives diseases and foes
Mercury.9: in the ninth Mercury gives success with regard to good qualities and money
Mercury.10: in the tenth honor and possessions
Mercury.11: in the eleventh the acquisition of lands, gold, and garments
Mercury.12: and in the twelfth honor from friends and money

Sun.1: Mercury in the place of the Sun destroys virility and the begetting (of children)
Sun.2: in the second it destroys property
Sun.3: in the third it causes fear of one's friends which is stirred up by one's enemies
Sun.4: in the fourth separation from one's family (kutumba)
Sun.5: in the fifth Mercury produces position, fame, and renown
Sun.6: in the sixth it gives intelligence and wealth
Sun.7: in the seventh Mercury causes non-agitation and ascetic indifference
Sun.8: in the eighth it gives diseases and strife
Sun.9: in the ninth Mercury produces money, knowledge, firmness, and righteousness (dharma)
Sun.10: in the tenth it destroys the good
Sun.11: in the eleventh Mercury gives the acquisition of lands and quadrupeds
Sun.12: and in the twelfth science and happiness

Saturn.1: Mercury in the place of Saturn gives benefits, joys, and brilliance
Saturn.2: in the second lands and wealth
Saturn.3: in the third it causes breaking, wandering, diseases, and anger
Saturn.4: in the fourth victory, gain, joy, and money
Saturn.5: in the fifth the destruction of one's possessions and sons
Saturn.6: in the sixth wind (-diseases), blows from boulders, and fevers
Saturn.7: in the seventh Mercury causes payments and beauty
Saturn.9: in the ninth it gives wealth and honor
Saturn.10: in the tenth it produces position, wealth, and money
Saturn.11: in the eleventh Mercury causes the acquisition of lands, wealth, and gold

Jupiter.1: Mercury in the place of Jupiter gives the destruction of one's wealth and knowledge
Jupiter.2: in the second it takes away friends and property
Jupiter.3: in the third it destroys joy and strength
Jupiter.4: in the fourth Mercury gives strife and delusion
Jupiter.5: in the fifth Mercury (causes) the loss of one's wealth and honor
Jupiter.6: in the sixth victory, good health, wealth, and children
Jupiter.7: in the seventh loss and disease
Jupiter.8: in the eighth the acquisition of wealth is predicted
Jupiter.9: in the ninth (it causes) wounds, distress, and delusions
Jupiter.10: in the tenth ( diseases of the) blood, fatigue, and the loss of one's possessions
Jupiter.11: in the eleventh goods and prosperity
Jupiter.12: and in the twelfth it gives fear

Venus.1: Mercury in the place of Venus gives sons, women, and sciences
Venus.3: in the third honor and victory
Venus.4: in the fourth a collection of multi-colored paintings
Venus.5: in the fifth Mercury produces cows, lands, and children
Venus.6: in the sixth diseases and the loss of one's money
Venus.7: in the seventh the loss of one's wife, sons, and possessions
Venus.8: in the eighth success with regard to wealth and honor
Venus.9: in the ninth Mercury causes the acquisition of friends and money
Venus.10: in the tenth the loss of one's wealth and fatigue
Venus.11: in the eleventh it causes the gaining of women, gold, clothes, and food

Mars.1: Mercury in the place of Mars and in the second place gives wealth which produces at a good interest-rate
Mars.2: Mercury in the place of Mars and in the second place gives wealth which produces at a good interest-rate
Mars.3: in the third it causes disrespect from others and weariness
Mars.4: in the fourth friends, glory, and honor
Mars.5: in the fifth it gives expenses, wandering, and poverty
Mars.6: in the sixth an increase in one's foes and diseases
Mars.7: in the seventh Mercury causes the acquisition of women, beautiful girls, and food
Mars.9: in the ninth Mercury produces success with regard to honor and wealth
Mars.10: in the tenth joy, authority, and glory
Mars.11: in the eleventh success with regard to money
Mars.12: and in the twelfth the desired reversal of evil

Moon.1: Mercury in the place of the Moon takes away friendship, knowledge, intellect, and honor
Moon.2: in the second it produces reproaches, pains, quarrels, the interruption of one's business, and poverty
Moon.3: in the third Mercury causes obstruction by one's relatives, diseases, and calamity with respect to one's wealth
Moon.4: in the fourth the acquisition of honor, good qualities, praise, pleasure, women, and wealth
Moon.5: in the fifth Mercury produces calumny, anxiety, purposeless roaming, and distress
Moon.6: in the sixth it causes prosperity, mental joy, and the accumulation of power and possessions
Moon.7: in the seventh Mercury causes evil, journeys, torment, poverty, and the obstruction of one's wealth
Moon.8: in the eighth the help of wise men, intelligence, favor, status, and joy
Moon.9: in the ninth breaking, reproaches, wandering, fatigue, illness, and torments
Moon.10: in the tenth Mercury gives success in business, the acquisition of money, and the respect of men who have confidence in one
Moon.11: in the eleventh it produces honor, quadrupeds, women, friends, money, beauty, and pleasure
Moon.12: in the twelfth Mercury causes anxiety and fatigue from one's work

Ascendant.1: Mercury in the ascendent gives lordship, possessions, friends, women, ideas, knowledge, beauty, fame, and quadrupeds
Ascendant.2: in the second place it gives voice, intelligence, wealth, and friends
Ascendant.3: in the third it causes the attainment of harshness from one's relatives, separation from one's wife, and the loss of one's beauty
Ascendant.4: in the fourth Mercury gives friends, money, honor, knowledge, glory, relatives, and good qualities
Ascendant.5: in the fifth it gives an increase in one's beauty, the acquisition of sons and possessions, honor, and intelligence
Ascendant.6: in the sixth Mercury takes away beauty and wealth and gives dishonor, poverty, and strife
Ascendant.7: in the seventh Mercury gives good health, joy, the destruction of evil, and happiness
Ascendant.8: in the eighth it causes diseases, mental distraction, wanderings, and quarrels, and takes away friendship and intelligence
Ascendant.9: in the ninth Mercury gives the appearance of adoration, good health, and strength, and success with regard to righteousness (dharma) and money
Ascendant.10: in the tenth the acquisition of eloquence, the fine arts, sexual intercourse, women, honor, and wealth, and brilliance
Ascendant.11: in the eleventh Mercury gives the acquisition of women, friends, happiness, sons, and money, publicity, and the praise of wise men
Ascendant.12: and in the twelfth from the ascendent it produces strife and infamy
